notes.title: Magnytour at the Brussels Games Festival 2025
notes.notes: [p]On the occasion of the Brussels Games Festival, our visitors will benefit from a 10% discount on our video game and DLC during the week of August 28 to September 4, 2025. The video game enables to get to know the Magnytour game very quickly, it is possible to consult the online demo on Steam which is free to download: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971570/Magnytour/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Magnytour @ Steam Summer 2025 Sale
notes.notes: [p]Summer is here, and you can enjoy some well-deserved break with a 20% discount on the video game Magnytour and its DLC. Steam's summer sale runs from June 26 to July 10, 2025. Relive the sensations of the summer's grand tours with Magnytour and its race immersion, as if you were there.[/p][p]You can also create your own cycling tours and share them with your community thanks to our new race profiles option, which you can select as you wish.[/p][p]Get into the race with Magnytour video game![/p]

notes.title: Magnytour Shared-Screen Multiplayer with the New DLC!
notes.notes: The new DLC ‘Magnytour multijoueur local’ is a supplement to the basic video game. It now allows multiple players to play from the same PC. This is particularly advantageous for families. Parents and children can enjoy Magnytour racing in multiplayer mode on the same computer.

notes.notes:
The spring sales last for a week. This is your chance to immerse yourself in the world of the great classic cycle races or the first major tours of the season. 
You can also create your own cycling tours and share them with your community thanks to our new race profiles option, which you can select as you wish.
Get into the race with Magnytour video game!

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Here's the new Magnytour update! It includes :
-	16 new classic profiles with the same distances and gradients as in real life,
-	Drop-down menu in the lobby for quicker access to your favourite profiles,
-	Full ranking display,
-	Quick chat,
-	Improved dice algorithm,
-	Bug fixes.
Enter the race!
